name: Plunk
description: Plunk, The Open-Source Email Platform for AWS
composeYaml:
services:
  plunk:
    image: 'driaug/plunk:latest'
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      - 'REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379'
      - 'DATABASE_URL=postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgresql/plunk-db?schema=public'
      - 'JWT_SECRET=${JWTSECRET}'
      - 'AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION:?}'
      - 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:?}'
      - 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:?}'
      - 'AWS_SES_CONFIGURATION_SET=${AWS_SES_CONFIGURATION_SET:?}'
      - 'NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URI=${APP_URL}/api'
      - 'APP_URI=${APP_URL}'
      - 'API_URI=${APP_URL}/api'
      - 'DISABLE_SIGNUPS=${DISABLE_SIGNUPS:-False}'
      - NODE_OPTIONS=--no-network-family-autoselection
    entrypoint:
      - /app/entry.sh
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - '(wget -S --spider http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health 2>&1 | grep -q "HTTP/1.1 [1-3]")'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
  postgresql:
    image: 'postgres:16-alpine'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-plunk-db}'
    volumes:
      - 'plunk-postgresql-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
  redis:
    image: 'redis:7.4-alpine'
    volumes:
      - 'plunk-redis-data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - redis-cli
        - PING
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 20
